content.reason: Although Lekić's parcel-level remote-sensing and weather-data fusion work (e.g., SYN-PUB-00921, SYN-PRJ-1822) is technically relevant to field-level hail exposure mapping, the material states he left the University of Novi Sad in March 2026 and is now a postdoctoral researcher in Austria, so he is unavailable for this collaboration.
